research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Flock Freight, Inc. is focused on optimizing the pooling and shipping of freight. Their research delves into methods that allow for the consolidation of multiple less-than-full truckload shipments into a single full truckload. This approach ensures a full truckload service level guarantee, enhancing the efficiency of freight transportation. The company's development efforts aim to streamline the logistics process, potentially reducing costs and improving delivery times for shippers. Flock Freight's R&D is centered on refining these logistical methodologies.

overview_description.description:
Flock Freight is reimagining and reinventing the freight industry by relentlessly eliminating inefficiency and waste through algorithmic pooling.

Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and human-centric logistics management, Flock Freight tailors its shipping experience to meet your business’s needs. Flock Freight seamlessly pools any freight to find the perfect route, avoiding terminals and risky offloads so that a shipment travels safely and directly to its destination, damage-free. The result: on-time delivery with every shipment—guaranteed.

With venture capital from Google Ventures and SignalFire, Flock Freight is one of the largest startups in San Diego, California. The company's team is obsessed with aggressively growing its customer base, constantly improving the technology platform, and delivering a superior customer experience. 

Flock Freight aims to fundamentally change the $60 billion LTL freight industry across North America with FlockDirect—one pooled shipment at a time.

about_short_description.short_description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company that provides freight brokerage and transportation services through shared truckload shipping.

product.name: FlockDirect® Shared Truckload (STL)
product.description: A freight shipping service that pools shipments to share truckload space, allowing shippers to pay only for the space they need while receiving truckload-level service.

product.name: Standard Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Shipping
product.description: A freight shipping option for smaller shipments that do not fill a full truck, typically between one to six pallets or less than 10 linear feet, using traditional hub-and-spoke networks.

product.name: Full Truckload (TL) Shipping
product.description: A freight shipping service that reserves an entire trailer for a single shipment, ideal for loads exceeding 40 linear feet.

product.name: Automated Load Tracking
product.description: A system that provides real-time shipment location updates by integrating with carriers' electronic logging devices (ELDs) or using a mobile app for tracking.

product.name: Flock Freight Online Platform
product.description: A web-based platform for shippers and carriers to quote, book, track shipments, and manage freight operations, with capabilities for multiple users and integration with TMS.

identifier.value: Carrier Network and Load Bidding System

product.name: Carrier Network and Load Bidding System
product.description: A system that connects carriers with available freight loads, allowing carriers to bid on shipments and book loads through the Flock Freight platform.
